manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
